zones.label: Inner slot
zones.define: Within 30 feet, and no more than 30 degrees off the middle.

zones.label: Down low, wide
zones.define: Within 30 feet but off to the side, below the faceoff dots.

zones.label: High slot
zones.define: 30 to 50 feet out, no more than 25 degrees off the middle.

zones.label: Faceoff circles
zones.define: 30 to 50 feet out and off to the side.

zones.label: Point
zones.define: Farther than 50 feet but still inside the blue line.

zones.label: Outside the zone
zones.define: From the blue line or farther back.

team.label: Goals per game
team.define: Goals scored per game, every situation, overtime included. Shootouts don't count.

team.label: Goals against per game
team.define: Goals allowed per game, same rules.

team.label: xG per game
team.define: Expected goals from the team's unblocked shots, per game. How many goals its chances were worth.

team.label: xG against per game
team.define: Expected goals from the other team's unblocked shots, per game.

team.label: Share of the xG
team.define: Of all the expected goals in its games, the share that came from this team's shots. 50% is even.

team.label: Goals minus xG
team.define: Goals scored minus expected goals. Above zero means it scored more than its chances were worth: good shooters, or good luck.

team.label: Goals against minus xG against
team.define: Goals allowed minus expected goals allowed. Below zero means its goalies stopped more than the chances said they would.

team.label: xG per 60
team.define: Expected goals for every 60 minutes at 5-on-5.

team.label: xG against per 60
team.define: Expected goals against for every 60 minutes at 5-on-5.

team.label: Share of the xG
team.define: Share of the 5-on-5 expected goals that came from this team's shots.

team.label: Share of the goals
team.define: Share of the 5-on-5 goals this team scored. Next to the xG share, it shows how much the bounces helped or hurt.

team.label: Power-play minutes
team.define: Minutes with more skaters on the ice than the other team.

team.label: Power play: xG per 60
team.define: Expected goals for every 60 minutes of power play.

team.label: Power play: goals per 60
team.define: Goals for every 60 minutes of power play.

team.label: Penalty-kill minutes
team.define: Minutes with fewer skaters on the ice than the other team.

team.label: Penalty kill: xG against per 60
team.define: Expected goals allowed for every 60 minutes of penalty kill.

team.label: Penalty kill: goals against per 60
team.define: Goals allowed for every 60 minutes of penalty kill.

skater.label: Games
skater.define: Regular-season games with at least one shift.

skater.label: Minutes per game
skater.define: Average ice time per game, every situation.

skater.label: Goals
skater.define: Goals scored, every situation. Shootouts don't count.

skater.label: xG
skater.define: Expected goals from the player's own unblocked shots: what those chances were worth.

skater.label: Goals minus xG
skater.define: Goals minus the player's own expected goals. A big number either way over one season is mostly luck; over several it starts to mean finishing skill.

skater.label: Unblocked shots per 60
skater.define: The player's unblocked shots for every 60 minutes played.

skater.label: xG per 60
skater.define: The player's own expected goals for every 60 minutes played.

skater.label: 5-on-5 minutes
skater.define: Minutes played with five skaters and a goalie on each side.

skater.label: Team's share of the xG
skater.define: With the player on the ice at 5-on-5, the share of the expected goals that came from the player's team. 50% is even.

skater.label: Team xG per 60
skater.define: The player's team's expected goals for every 60 minutes with the player on the ice at 5-on-5.

skater.label: Team xG against per 60
skater.define: The other team's expected goals for every 60 minutes with the player on the ice at 5-on-5.

skater.label: Team's share of the goals
skater.define: Of the 5-on-5 goals scored with the player on the ice, the share the player's team scored.

goalie.label: Unblocked shots faced
goalie.define: Shots on goal plus misses faced while in net. Empty-net shots don't count.

goalie.label: xG faced
goalie.define: What those shots were worth in expected goals.

goalie.label: Goals saved above expected
goalie.define: xG faced minus goals allowed. Above zero means more stops than an average goalie would have made on the same shots.

goalie.label: Goals saved above expected per 100 shots
goalie.define: The same thing, for every 100 unblocked shots, so busy and quiet goalies compare fairly.

goalie.label: Save rate on unblocked shots
goalie.define: Share of the unblocked shots faced that didn't go in. Misses count as stops, so this runs higher than save percentage.

goalie.label: Expected save rate
goalie.define: What that save rate would have been if goals went in exactly as often as xG says.
